note: Expression-logic check on literal rows, not an ERP finding. names_match is nameNorm(vendor_name) <=> name_norm, the same expression as the DQ9 count.
sql: SELECT label, vendor_name, name_norm, (trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> name_norm) AS names_match FROM (SELECT 'mismatch' AS label, 'Northwind Incorporated' AS vendor_name, 'SOUTH CO' AS name_norm UNION ALL SELECT 'match', 'Northwind Incorporated', 'NORTHWIND INC') s LIMIT 5
